what: Clicking a same-site link spreads a stage-color circle (clip-path) from the click point to the screen edge in 560ms cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), shows the destination name, then navigates. 60ms after the new page opens, the circle shrinks back to the same point in 640ms and clears (the position is passed via sessionStorage)

options.in: Covering duration (seconds), default .56 — 0 skips covering and moves on right away
options.wait: Delay (sec) before the walk on a new page, default .06
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: (if present) cover panel — if not, the part makes a stage-colored panel
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (If present) spot inside the overlay that receives the destination name — the link’s data-label, otherwise the link text

note: Same-page # links, new windows, downloads and other sites are left alone. The same part must be attached to the destination page for the curtain to lift.

from.where: All pages — an ink-colored circle covers the page from the clicked spot and shows Name. / Destination, then lifts away on the new page
